text_block_list.text:
I came to a shrine with Air Groove for a 
change of pace today, but...

Upon seeing the long flight of stairs 
leading to the shrine grounds, Air Groove 
declared that she would train right 
here...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's pay our respects at the shrine 
first.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because I am training. 
After all, I am borrowing the shrine's 
stairs.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A feeling of gratitude is something you 
should convey to the gods.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And you, don't stand there! That's the 
pathway of the gods. Walk along the edge.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Good grief, it is only proper courtesy...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's go pray at the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Clear your mind and pray. That, too, is a 
form of respect toward the gods.
(Clap, clap)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I have conveyed our gratitude for letting 
us use the shrine grounds. Now we can 
train to our hearts' content."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmm...? I feel kinda lighter...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, could this be the effect of praying 
at the shrine?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Body and mind feel deeply connected, honed 
to absolute sharpness...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's head straight to the stairs 
for some training. Keep up with me!

Afterward, when we began training on the 
stairs, she went on to record a great 
time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Alright, shall we begin training then?

And so, we started stair training, but she 
couldn't run the way she wanted to...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Kh... Is this due to my own immaturity as 
well? To make such an unsightly display 
before the gods...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, I must devote myself to even 
greater diligence to ensure nothing like 
this ever happens again...
